title: Chapter 38 The History Of The Hongmeng Universe
content:
Chapter 38 The History Of The Hongmeng Universe

I don't know how long it took.

One day, a tired Lu Daosheng finally returned to the deserted city.

"Huh, this trip was not easy."

"Xiaoxue."

"Huh?! Xiaoxue!!"

"Someone come!"

The next moment, Jiang Yuan suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord, you are back."

However, Lu Daosheng looked a little flustered, frowning and said, "Where is Xiaoxue?"

"Lord City Lord, the young lady left with Lord Ouyang and Lord Aoqing. As for where she went, I don't know."

"What! Who asked her to leave? Why didn't you stop her?"

Hearing that his daughter actually left quietly.

Lu Daosheng was a little angry.

Immediately, Jiang Yuan knelt on the ground.

"Lord City Lord, calm down."

This was the first time he saw Lu Daosheng so angry.

Taking a deep breath, Lu Daosheng calmed down a little, knowing that it was not Jiang Yuan's fault.

"Mr. Jiang, please leave."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Jiang Yuan left, and Lu Daosheng looked up at the starry sky, feeling extremely worried.

Although Ao Qing and Ouyang Yanqing, two powerful people, followed him, Lu Daosheng was still worried.

Of course, it was not because he was worried about Lu Xue's safety, but because he was afraid that his daughter would meet some bad people and lead his precious daughter astray.

As for Lu Xue's safety.

Haha, the backup he left on Lu Xue could even wipe out an entire galaxy.

As long as the opponent's strength is not as strong as his, his daughter will be absolutely safe.

And at this moment, Jiang Yuan came back again.

I saw that Jiang Yuan respectfully handed a letter to Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord, this is the envelope that I found in front of your door. I think it should be left by the young lady."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's eyelids jumped, and then he quickly took the envelope and read it.

"Dad, my daughter wants to see how big the outside world is. Just think of it as my birthday gift. Don't worry."

Looking at the envelope, Lu Daosheng remained silent for a long time.

Birthday.

Since the advent of the system, he seems to have never celebrated his birthday again.

He even forgot his daughter's birthday.

For a moment, Lu Daosheng's heart was extremely complicated.

It seems that he needs to reflect on it.

"Well, let you indulge yourself for once."

Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, then slowly walked into the house.

......

Practicing without time, in a blink of an eye, the countdown to the hundred-year invasion of evil demons is only the last ten years.

Now, the boundary of the universe is already full of demonic energy, and a stream of strange power continues to overflow from the cracks at the boundary of the universe.

"Old Yang, it seems that my Hongmeng Universe has little time left."

On the border, a strong man looked at the scene in front of him with a helpless smile on his face.

Hearing this, Old Yang looked indifferent.

"When the enemy comes, we will fight him. When the water comes, we will block it with earth. Before, our Hongmeng Universe was able to repel the evil demons. This time, we can do the same."

Hearing this, the people around him immediately regained some confidence.

But although Old Yang said so, he was not very sure.

After all, the strength of the Hongmeng Universe today is far less than that of the last universe war. This time, after all, is more tragic than the last war.

Looking at the nearly hundreds of strong men around him, Old Yang's face was indifferent, but his heart was full of sorrow.

These are already the top combat forces in the universe. If even they can't stand it, who else can protect the Hongmeng Universe?

Could it be that the Hongmeng Universe really can't escape this disaster?

.........

In the deserted city.

On this day, countless strong men in the city lord's mansion put down their affairs and rushed to the hall.

Just because of the call of the greatest existence in the deserted city, the city lord.

"Subordinates, meet the Lord City Lord!"

In the hall, Gu Chen and others greeted Lu Daosheng respectfully.

At the top, Lu Daosheng glanced at several people and immediately showed a satisfied smile.

Over the years, his subordinates have made great progress.

Gu Chen, A Wei, An Xing and others have all entered the unknown realm.

And Yun Qi has not made much progress in cultivation because he created a new army, but he has still reached the peak of the unknown realm.

However, these strengths are still not enough to fight against the evil demons.

So Lu Daosheng wants to focus on them and improve them again.

"Ten years later, the evil demons will completely break through the boundary barrier of the universe and invade our Hongmeng universe, so your strength needs to be improved again."

Lu Daosheng said slowly.

Then, the world in the palm of his hand emerged.

Then the law of time flows rapidly.

One year in the outside world, ten thousand years in the inner world.

"Again, how big a breakthrough you can make depends on you."

Seeing the world in the palm of your hand, everyone was extremely excited.

Only those who have been there can understand the mysteries and opportunities there. It is really cool.

"Thank you, Lord City Lord. We will not disappoint you."

Then, everyone trembled and entered the world in the palm of their hand.

Suddenly, the hall returned to peace again.

Looking at the world in the palm of their hand, everyone was looking for opportunities to improve their strength. Lu Daosheng also put his mind at ease and took out a mirror.

This thing is also a rare treasure in the world, a magic weapon of deduction.

Lu Daosheng had a thought, and a woman's image suddenly appeared in the mirror.

It was none other than his daughter, Lu Xue.

After so many years, Lu Xue still hadn't come back, but Lu Daosheng wasn't angry.

Because at this moment, Lu Xue was sitting in a mysterious dojo, with countless pure energy and some inheritances constantly flowing into Lu Xue's body.

This was Lu Xue's chance.

And Lu Daosheng had also deduced that it would be good for Lu Xue.

So Lu Daosheng didn't interfere, but it took too long.

Not far from Lu Xue, Ouyang Yan was sitting quietly, like a transparent person.

But as long as there was any danger around her, she would take action instantly.

As for Ao Qing, he seemed to have fallen asleep at this moment.

However, his huge and winding body surrounded the entire dojo.

In the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng put away the mirror and sat there in deep thought.

My own strength, looking at the entire Hongmeng Universe, is absolutely invincible.

What about the people outside.

For example, the Wanling Realm.

In the Wanling Realm, will there be beings above the Tianming Realm?

In an instant, Lu Daosheng became extremely curious about the strength of the Wanling Realm.

He knew that he would set off for the Wanling Realm soon after solving the evil demon clan.

Before that, it might not be a bad thing to learn about it in advance.

Ao Qing.

The only Wanling Realm creature in the Hongmeng Universe.

Wait, how could I forget that guy.

The guy guarding the long river of time and space.

That guy recognized my strength, and he also accurately told the strength of my Tianming.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng immediately reached into the void, and then stretched out his hand and pulled. The next moment, a long river full of endless time and space laws and the breath of the avenue appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

However, the long river of time and space was extremely silent, and there was not even a shadow.

This made Lu Daosheng frown slightly.

Then Lu Daosheng stepped directly into the long river of time and space, and went upstream in the direction of the upstream. This move can be said to be unprecedented.

As we all know, the long river of time and space records all the things that happened in history.

Therefore, when Lu Daosheng went upstream, he also saw countless things before the Hongmeng Universe.

For example, when his deserted city was just rebuilt.

His wife left.

Lu Xue was born.

He met his wife for the first time.

Just came to this world.

Going forward, Lu Daosheng saw a lot more.

The Hongmeng Universe gradually declined.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly, and then his speed suddenly accelerated a bit.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng saw a tall figure.

It stood above the Tianxuan World, and hid a legacy in a corner of the Tianxuan World with an indescribable means.

And that place is the current Evil God Abyss.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was a little shocked.

But he did not guess, but continued to move forward.

The evil demon clan fought with countless top powerhouses in the Hongmeng Universe, among which there was the body he had just seen.

According to ancient books, in the ancient times, the Xuan Gu Galaxy was in a three-way battle.

Later, the evil demons invaded, and the eight kings joined the battle, and finally all died.

So, the man just now was Xuan Wang, one of the eight kings of the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

It seems that he had already known his own ending, so he had passed his inheritance to the Tianxuan World in advance.

And Lu Daosheng also knew why the evil demon clan appeared in the Tianxuan World.

The other party's purpose should be the inheritance left by Xuan Wang.

However, they were suppressed by Gu Chen, and the place where they were suppressed happened to be the Evil God Abyss.

This is outrageous.

What's even more outrageous is that he didn't even notice it.

This Xuan Wang is really good.

And the other party knew his own ending, but still resolutely chose to fight the evil demon.

For this reason, Lu Daosheng admired him immensely.

Just when Lu Daosheng wanted to move forward, a bitter voice suddenly sounded from the field.

"Senior, please don't move forward."
